_readme: Curated list behind tools.ordinary.co/scripts. Versions, dates and what's-new come from the live manifest the publisher posts (scripts/publisher). Edit blurbs, groups and glyphs here; a glyph is 16 rows of 16 characters, # = ink. Paths are relative to the Dropbox root (the folder that holds _Ordinary Folk Projects).

time-tracker-app.label: OF Time Tracker Mac app
time-tracker-app.path: _Ordinary Folk Projects/_OF TOOL BOX/Apps - OF/OF Time Tracker Mac App sync

groups.title: After Effects
groups.note: All on one shelf in Dropbox. Make the folder Available Offline once; the loaders then always run the newest version.

tools.name: Smart Queue
tools.blurb: Queues the comp in the right _Renders folder with the next version number, in one click.
does: Reads the project's folder conventions and prefills destination, filename and version for the active comp or a selection of comps.
One confirm dialog: rename comps to match, archive earlier versions, overwrite the latest, render right away.
The loader runs the newest build on the shelf, so updates need nothing from you.

tools.name: Word Split
tools.blurb: Splits a text layer into one text layer per word, parented to the hidden original.
does: Select a text layer and run it: every word becomes its own layer, placed exactly where it was.
The original becomes a hidden guide layer. Edit it and run again to re-lay out the words.
Keyframes and effects on the original carry over to the words; an optional live link keeps text and style in sync.

tools.name: BP Scripture Animator

files.entry: BP Scripture Animator - Edit in panel.jsx
files.entryLabel: Opens the panel on the selected comp. Point KBar here; install the panel once with the installer below.

kbar.note: opens the panel on the selected comp

tools.blurb: Scripture text boxes for BibleProject episodes, from a web editor straight into AE.
install: Panel: run BP Scripture Animator - Install panel.jsx once (File > Scripts > Run Script File), restart AE, then Window > Extensions > BP Scripture Animator.
Turn on Preferences > Scripting & Expressions > Allow Scripts to Write Files and Access Network.
does: Write the passage in the editor: reveal chunks, original-language chips, underlines, highlights, boxes, focus, timed to the voice-over.
Build it in AE as plain text and shape layers, and update it later without losing what you changed in AE.
The panel in Window > Extensions is the same editor talking to AE directly.

tools.name: Make Footage Local
tools.blurb: Makes a comp's online-only Dropbox footage local with one Finder right-click.
does: Scans the active comp, precomps, sequences and proxies included, and finds the files Dropbox keeps online-only.
Opens one Finder window with exactly those files selected: right-click > Make Available Offline.
Reloads each footage item in AE as it lands, with count, size and time left. Hold Shift while launching to scan the whole project.

tools.name: Reset Timeline Columns
tools.blurb: Puts every comp's timeline columns back in AE's default order.
does: AE has no scripting access to columns, so it saves the project, rewrites the per-comp column record inside the .aep and reopens it.
Keeps a backup copy in the system temp folder. Column widths and visibility stay as they were.

tools.name: Audio From Parent
tools.blurb: Brings the top comp's audio into the precomp you're in, offset and trimmed to line up.
does: Walks up to the top-most comp that uses this precomp and takes the audio you hear there: a sound file, or the mix precomp.
Adds it at the bottom as a guide layer with the right offset, trimmed to the precomp's length, so it never plays twice.
Run it again to replace the layer.

tools.name: Typewriter Slider
tools.blurb: Adds a Typewriter slider to selected text layers: the value is how many characters show.
does: Keyframe the slider from 0 to the text length to type the text on.
Running it again on a layer keeps its slider and resets it to the full length.

tools.name: Extract Comp Info
tools.blurb: Writes the layers, masks, effects and keyframes of selected comps to one text file.
does: Pick comps in a dialog (pre-selected from the Project panel) and choose where to save.
You get a readable .txt with transforms, keyframes, expressions, masks, effects and Essential Properties per layer.
Good for comparing two builds, or handing a comp's setup to someone (or to Claude).

tools.name: Dropbox Finder Links

files.entryLabel: Double-click to install or update (right-click > Open the first time).

tools.blurb: Paste a folder link in Slack that opens that folder in the clicker's own Finder.
install: Mac: double-click Install dbxlinks.command (right-click > Open the first time), then switch on Finder > Quick Actions > Customize > Copy Slack Link.
Windows: run windows/Install dbxlinks.bat in the same folder.
does: The menu bar icon or the Finder quick action copies a link for the selected folder; a teammate clicks it and Finder opens it on their Mac.
Also powers the Open in Finder buttons on this page. Updates itself from the team Dropbox.

tools.name: OF Time Tracker app
tools.blurb: Menu bar timer for the Time Tracker. Copy the app from Dropbox into Applications.
install: Select OF Time Tracker.app, Cmd+C, then Cmd+V in Applications. Never drag it: a move removes it from Dropbox for everyone. Update the same way.
No security warning: it arrives through Dropbox sync, not a browser download.
does: Lives in the Dock and as a clock in the menu bar, and signs in with your OF account.
The web app is at /time-tracker on this hub.
